title: Eight production-quality gaps
summary: What blocks Blueprint from being production-quality today (nine gaps as of late 2026-05-25 — Gap 9 surfaced during this initiative's Stage 3 portal work). Each gap maps to a named pattern from primary sources.

strategy.decision: Enumerate the eight gaps, name the pattern that closes each, collapse them into two load-bearing prescription wedges plus three independent items.
strategy.why: Blueprint's first principle says agent struggle is a missing capability — encode it. Eight named struggles from real adoption (or non-adoption) attempts are the source material for the prescription. Without enumerating them, the prescription would be aspirational instead of evidence-grounded. See research/current-state/02-blueprint-production-quality-gaps.md.
strategy.shipped: Current Blueprint has no gap inventory. The 2026-05-25 three-session reconciliation surfaced four-way root-doc drift implicitly; the eight-gap framing was authored as part of this redesign.
strategy.gap: Implicit pain (a session gets stuck and can't articulate why) becomes explicit framework (gap N, pattern P closes it, lands in wedge W).
strategy.question: Are there gaps consumers experience that aren't in this inventory? Validation needed once v1 ships and adoption signal exists.

currentState.route: GitHub repo browsing — no current-state inventory exists
currentState.summary: Operators learn about Blueprint's limitations by hitting them. No published surface enumerates the gaps.
currentState.annotation: The proposed gap inventory exists as research artifacts in this initiative; the redesign promotes them to the portal so stakeholders + future operators can read them directly without git archaeology.
